offer_clarity.what_nf_is: Not Forgotten does NOT generate leads. It works with opportunities you've already generated and quoted. It makes sure those quotes don't disappear because nobody followed them up — and gives you visibility into what happened after each quote.
offer_clarity.proof: $180,115 across 14 jobs came from following up existing quotes.
offer_clarity.do_not_imply: No guaranteed jobs, revenue, or conversion. No lead generation. No unsupported recovery attribution.
